close_reason: Expanded Error enum with CRL/OCSP-specific variants, Display, and std::error::Error with source()
description:
Define the pkix_revocation::Error enum with Display and std::error::Error impls.

BLOCKED BY: PKIX-e9v (Display/Error impl pattern should be consistent with pkix-path).

This is the first issue in the revocation epic. It establishes the error type that CrlChecker and OcspChecker will return, and the type that RevocationChecker::check_revocation returns after PKIX-b9z is fixed.

Variants:
  Revoked {
    // The serial number of the revoked certificate (for logging/diagnostics)
    serial: x509_cert::serial_number::SerialNumber,
    // RFC 5280 §5.3.1 reason code if present in the CRL entry (0=unspecified)
    reason_code: Option<u8>,
  }
  CrlExpired   — CRL thisUpdate/nextUpdate window has expired
  CrlSignatureInvalid   — CRL signature did not verify against issuer SPKI
  CrlParseError(der::Error)  — DER parse failure
  OcspSignatureInvalid
  OcspStatusUnknown   — OCSP responder returned 'unknown' status (hard-fail)
  OcspParseError(der::Error)

impl fmt::Display for Error: human-readable messages for each variant.
#[cfg(feature = std)] impl std::error::Error for Error with source() returning inner der::Error where applicable.

Result type alias: pub type Result<T> = core::result::Result<T, Error>;
title: pkix-revocation: define Error enum
